title: The developer console with default password and debug on, copied into the production image and bound to every interface on a public host

planted.why: the default password protects a console that the Dockerfile ships and serves on 0.0.0.0 on a public host: anyone on the internet can sign in and edit users and flags

proof.python:
d = open('Dockerfile').read()
assert 'COPY dev/' in d and 'dev_server.py' in d
assert 'serve("0.0.0.0")' in open('dev/dev_server.py').read()
assert 'public host' in open('deploy.md').read()
